conviction_note: The company-level negatives are mostly arithmetic on public numbers: Q3 volumes were pre-released on 2026-09-28 at about two-thirds of the 2H guide, the Brent collars cap realised prices at $89.39 against a $96 Q3 Brent average, and cash was $21.6m at 30 June. On the other side the short is very crowded (28% of shares, 8.2 days to cover), the stock already fell 33% in five sessions on the 3 Nov election, and the call book is heavy. So p_up is only slightly under 50 (47) on a large abs move (17, near the 18.3% implied). The findings sum (-0.6) and the scaled number (-1.0) agree in sign and size.
bar: Disputed, so every finding is capped small. finviz (2026-11-02): Q3 EPS -$0.36 on revenue $132.5m (https://finviz.com/news/413632/sable-offshore-faces-a-credibility-test-as-street-expects-a-swing-back-to-losses). MarketBeat search summary: EPS -$0.16 on revenue $157.47m (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-sable-offshore-soc-projected-to-post-earnings-on-monday-2026-11-02/). Benzinga: $0.14 on $214.3m, probably stale (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SOC/earnings-forecasts). There is no company guide for the quarter except volumes: the 2H26 guide is 47.5-52.5k gross bopd (Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001831481/000183148126000105/a991_2q26xpr.htm), and Q3 sales of ~32-34k gross were pre-released on 2026-09-28. My own revenue read is ~$150-170m: about 2.55m net bbl (32.7k gross x 0.85) at $58-66/bbl realised (Q3 Brent ~$96 less a $30-38 discount). That is +8% against a ~$145m midpoint of the two current sources.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest (via equibles): 54.39m shares short on the 2026-10-15 settlement, ~28.3% of 191.9m shares outstanding (more as a share of float), 8.16 days to cover. It was 54.19m on 09-30 and 43.0m on 07-31, so the short has been building (https://equibles.com/stocks/soc/short-interest). Part of it is probably convertible-arbitrage hedging on the $345m 6.5% converts ($4.00 conversion price), which carry a low delta at $1.85. Baseline options: skew_25d is null; put/call open-interest ratio 0.18, so the book is call-heavy; ATM IV 161%; event-implied move 18.3% (ATM spread 59% of mid, indicative only). Tape: -32.6% over 5d, -50.1% over 20d, -90% from the 52-week high, 1.9% above the 52-week low. A crowded short with call-heavy retail positioning shrinks every negative below.

findings.finding: The 2H26 volume guide has to be cut in the release. The 2026-09-28 8-K pre-released gross sales of ~32k bopd for Jul-Aug and ~34k expected for Sep, against a 2H26 guide of 47.5-52.5k gross (net 40-45k). Holding that guide would need Q4 to average ~62-71k gross, but October nominations were only ~38k with a ~45k exit before Hondo. Hondo itself slipped from September to 'Q4 2026'. The live question is whether the FY2027 guide (50-55k gross, net 42.5-47.5k, LOE $9-12/boe) also comes down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 (2026-08-10) missed revenue badly ($137.1m vs ~$227-238m) and kept the 2H guide while cutting capex: -8.64%. Nov 2025 (loan amendment / financing): -28.86%. The name has sold off on 4 of its last 5 prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The Q3 volumes have been public since 28 Sep and the stock is -50% in 20 days. What is not visibly priced is a cut to the FY2027 guide. If it were, the 18% implied move would be compressed and the short would be covering rather than at a new high (54.4m on 10-15).
findings.independence: The Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001831481/000183148126000105/a991_2q26xpr.htm) gives the 2H and 2027 guides. Trigram Partners (2026-11-05, https://trigram.substack.com/p/sable-offshore-corp-nyse-soc) does the same comparison of 32-38k against 47.5-52.5k. Same company documents; not independent of each other.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP will carry a hedge loss on collars the company is effectively over-hedged on. The Brent costless collars entered July 2026 cover 28.0k bopd for 2H26 with a $65 put and an $89.39 call; 2027 is 25.0k bopd with an $80.00 call, and 2028 is 21.0k bopd with a $73.17 call. Hedged volume exceeds Q3 net sales of ~27-28k bopd. Q3 Brent averaged ~$95.95 (September ~$114), which implies roughly $20-30m of realised settlement loss in Q3. With Brent around $100+ at 30 Sep, the 2026-28 collars should also carry an unrealised mark-to-market loss, my estimate on the order of $100-200m, i.e. ~$0.5-1.0 a share against an EPS bar of -$0.16 to -$0.36. The cash part also caps Q4: Brent is ~$100-110 in early November against the $89.39 call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print with the collars in place (they were entered after Q2). Q2's headline EPS miss (-$0.42 vs +$0.37 on one source) came with -8.64%.
findings.why_not_priced: The strikes are in the 10-Q and the Brent path is public, but none of the three consensus figures is anywhere near a $100m+ non-cash loss (they range from -$0.36 to +$0.14). On a thin, retail-heavy name the GAAP headline can print as a large miss. If this were priced, the EPS consensus would be below -$1.
findings.independence: Brent Q3 average of $95.95 from the EIA October STEO via Ship & Bunker (https://shipandbunker.com/news/world/921080-ship-bunker-raises-q4-bunker-price-outlook-by-another-124mt-as-eia-puts-q4-brent-above-100). The Q2 call (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-sable-offshore-posts-q2-2026-miss-as-shares-fall-93CH-4852298) puts the collars at ~26k Q3 / 29k Q4 with a ~$89.39 ceiling. The MTM size is my inference, not a company number.

findings.finding: Sept-30 liquidity is the number the release reveals. Cash was $21.6m at 30 June (from $97.7m at 31 Dec), against $206.7m of payables and accruals (from $99.4m). The July refinancing ($675m TLB at 15%, $332.5m net from the converts, $107m net equity) went to repay the Exxon loan and fees, and the 10-Q gives no pro-forma cash. The TLB costs about $25m of interest and ~$17m of amortisation a quarter, with a 100% excess-cash sweep and a $25m minimum liquidity. The 10-Q says 'additional capital will be required' to restart the remaining SYU wells, and $155m of ATM capacity remains. What the money buys is the Hondo and well restarts, but with the equity at $1.85 any equity raise is heavily dilutive. Going-concern doubt was lifted after the refinancing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Financing has been this name's worst line: Nov 2025 loan amendment -28.86% on the print day; June 2026 equity + convert offering -23% and an earlier ~50% one-day plunge on a raise plan (https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/sable-offshore-stock-tumbles-23-on-equity-and-debt-offerings-93CH-4767824).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is -90% from its high and the short is at a record. The Sept-30 cash figure, the payables paydown and whether the ATM was used in Q3/Q4 are not public. Management said on 10 Aug there had been no ATM sales in Q3 to date. A sign either way (comfortable cash or an RBL borrowing base set, against an ATM draw) would move the stock.
findings.independence: Trigram (2026-11-05) counts $1.02bn of debt and calls the margin of safety dependent on 'the oil continuing to flow' (https://trigram.substack.com/p/sable-offshore-corp-nyse-soc). Same filings; partly the same document as the hedge finding (the 10-Q), but a different line.

findings.finding: Hondo approval is still unannounced. The 2026-09-28 8-K said the Marine Minerals Administration's final review of the Hondo safety commissioning submission was expected in October 2026, with restart in Q4 (9 of 15 wells with ~600 bopd perf adds). I found no 8-K or press release announcing approval or restart through 6 Nov (EDGAR shows only two 13G filings since 09-29), though the company 8-K'd its previous operating milestones. Hondo also carries the sulfur fix (sulfur is ~$10 of the ~$30/bbl discount).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hondo has slipped twice (June to September to Q4). Q2's slip disclosure came with -8.64%; the 09-28 update was followed by a rise ('SOC Stock Rises As Sable Offshore Ramps Output', https://stockstotrade.com/news/sable-offshore-corp-soc-news-2026_10_02/).
findings.why_not_priced: The October milestone was dated by the company itself, and the release must state its status. An announced restart would be a squeeze trigger into a 28% short. A further slip extends the sulfur discount and the volume shortfall. The price at the 52-week low reads more like a slip than a restart.
findings.independence: Company 8-K of 09-28 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1831481/000183148126000113/a991_socxhondopressrelease.htm). The silence is an absence, not a document, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Crowded short into the print. FINRA short interest is 54.39m shares (~28% of shares outstanding), 8.16 days to cover at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up from 43.0m at 07-31. Options open interest is call-heavy (put/call OI 0.18). The stock fell ~27% on 4-5 Nov to $1.82 and sits 1.9% above its 52-week low. Any positive surprise (Hondo restart, RBL borrowing base, comfortable cash, an unchanged 2027 guide) meets a short that needs 8 days of volume to cover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: +14.87% on the 2025-05-09 print and +4.24% on 2026-02-27; individual days of +20% and +37% on pipeline/legal news (https://www.tipranks.com/news/the-fly/sable-offshore-rises-20-0).
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price, so this is the mechanism rather than an unpriced fact. Some of the short is convert-hedge rather than directional, so the squeeze fuel is smaller than 28% suggests. It is sized against the negatives, not as an independent bull case.
findings.independence: Baseline put/call OI ratio of 0.18 and 5-day -32.6% (sealed baseline file). Trigram's $1.82 close on 11-05 (https://trigram.substack.com/p/sable-offshore-corp-nyse-soc).

findings.finding: The 4-5 Nov drop has a dated cause: the 3 Nov midterms. AP projected Democrats winning both chambers (Senate 54-44, House ~238-147), and Rep. Carbajal said on 4 Nov that a Democratic Congress will take 'more definitive action' against Sable, which is relying on a federal DPA order and an eminent-domain push. SOC fell 20.2% on 4 Nov and 8.1% on 5 Nov. The new Congress sits in 2027, and Congress cannot revoke the executive DPA order inside the window. Management can address the risk on the 9 Nov call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Political/legal headlines have moved this name 20-40% in a day, both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced; the drop is the pricing. The small positive is the gap between a 27% two-day repricing and an exposure that cannot bite before 2027. There is no dated mechanism to close that gap inside the window beyond the call, hence the small size.
findings.independence: Price path: MarketBeat close $1.98 -20.16% on 11-04 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/SOC/); Trigram 11-05 '27% over November 4 and 5' with no other cause named.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue should come in above the lower consensus. Pre-released gross sales of ~32.7k bopd average are ~2.55m net bbl at the guided ~0.85 net/gross ratio. At Q3 Brent of ~$96 less a $30-38/bbl discount (management called Q3 the low point for marketing economics), that is ~$150-170m of revenue against $132.5m (finviz) or $157.5m (MarketBeat). Q2 was $137.1m on ~1.91m net bbl ($71.7/bbl).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 revenue missed by ~40% and the stock fell 8.6%. Revenue has not been the line the stock trades on; financing and legal have.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is disputed between three sources, so a revenue beat against $132.5m may or may not be a beat against what holders carry. It is capped small for that reason, and because the hedge loss (finding 2) offsets most of the price benefit at the cash level.
findings.independence: The EIA Q3 Brent average via Ship & Bunker (https://shipandbunker.com/news/world/921080-ship-bunker-raises-q4-bunker-price-outlook-by-another-124mt-as-eia-puts-q4-brent-above-100) is independent of the company. The volume input shares the 09-28 8-K with finding 1.

outside_window.finding: Second-phase refinancing of the 15% TLB is planned after a full 3P reserve report expected in Q1 2027 (Q2 call). It is a positive if it lands, but it is dated after the window.
California's Ninth Circuit appeal of Judge Wilson's 2026-08-19 ruling upholding the DPA order and PHMSA oversight. I found no decision date.
The Democratic-controlled Congress takes office in January 2027 and has promised action against Sable.
Federal draft review (reported 2026-10-24) threatens to strip California's coastal authority unless the state takes corrective actions; the state statement is due by January.

searched_and_found_nothing: Any Sable 8-K or press release after 2026-09-29 other than the 10-26/10-30 earnings-date notice (EDGAR submissions API: only 13G filings on 10-08 and 10-19)
A Hondo MMA approval or restart announcement in Oct-Nov 2026
A company-specific trigger for the 11-04 -20% day beyond the election (no 8-K, no analyst action found)
Analyst rating or target changes in Nov 2026 (only JPM initiation 10-02 OW $10 and William Blair outperform 10-05 found)
Pro-forma cash after the July refinancing (not stated in the 10-Q or on the Q2 call)

baseline_tension: Run-up and positioning cut against my company-level negatives: the stock is -50% in 20 days with a 28% short and a call-heavy book, so the guide cut and hedge losses are largely in the price. That is why p_up sits at 47 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (crowded short, 28% / 8.2 DTC): guidance-cut finding -1.5 -> -1.0, liquidity -0.8 -> -0.5, Hondo silence -0.5 -> -0.3; p_up 46 -> 47.
Rule 6 (bar disputed across three sources): revenue-beat finding +0.5 -> +0.3; hedge/EPS-headline finding capped.
Rule 2 (one-off below operating income): hedge MTM finding -1.5 -> -0.8, since the non-cash mark has no direct path to the guide; the cash cap on realised prices keeps it negative.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): what the money buys (Hondo and well restarts, Exxon takeout, going concern lifted) kept the liquidity finding small and negative rather than large.

Rule 5 (an absence is not a cause): Hondo-silence finding kept small; the election finding kept because the drop does have a dated, sourced cause, but at +0.2 (from +0.3) since it has no in-window mechanism.
